captionStarter: Raiders 35-27 over Saints. Vegas is 3-0 after erasing an 11-point deficit.
concept: Quick hit: Saints' fourth-quarter turnover counter ticking up next to the Raiders' 3-0 record
description: The Las Vegas Raiders beat the New Orleans Saints 35-27 to move to 3-0, overcoming an 11-point second-half deficit after New Orleans committed four turnovers in the fourth quarter.
headline: Raiders stay unbeaten, survive Saints comeback 35-27
